newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Countdown of events as China takes over Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Countdown of events as China takes over Hong Kong.

text.p: Here is a timetable of main events surrounding the handover of the British colony of Hong Kong to China at midnight on Monday June 30. All are in Hong Kong unless stated.
JUNE 30
- Last day of British colonial rule. Public holiday.
* 4.30 pm (0830 GMT) - Governor Chris Patten due to depart from Government House for royal yacht Britannia.
* Afternoon - Arrival of Chinese President Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng.
* 6.15 pm (1015 GMT) - Sunset farewell ceremony of outgoing British administration and military forces. East Tamar garrison parade ground on Hong Kong waterfront.
* 7.30 pm (1130 GMT) - Cocktail reception for 4,000 handover ceremony guests. Hong Kong Exhibition and Convention Centre.
* 7.45 pm (1145 GMT) - British Prime Minister Tony Blair in summit talks with Jiang.
* 8 pm (1200 GMT) - Harbour fireworks display.
* 9 pm (1300 GMT) - Banquet for 4,000 guests of honour. Convention Centre.
* 9 pm (1300 GMT) - About 500 PLA troops expected to cross over land border into Hong Kong.
* 9 pm (1300 GMT) - Pro-democracy vigil throughout the night, including plans by democrats to hold protest at Legislative Council building in early hours of Chinese rule.

* 11.30 pm (1530 GMT) - Handover ceremony begins. British and Hong Kong flags to be lowered ahead of midnight (1600 GMT). Chinese flag and new Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) flag to be hoisted after midnight.
* Midnight (1600 GMT) - Sovereignty of the British colony of Hong Kong reverts to China.
* BEIJING - Midnight (1600 GMT) - Grand celebrations in China. Fireworks display in Tiananmen Square to mark handover.
JULY 1
- China resumes sovereignty of Hong Kong. Public holiday.

* 0.15 am (1615 GMT on June 30) - Britain's Prince Charles and Patten, the 28th and last British colonial governor, depart on the royal yacht Britannia. Commander British Forces Bryan Dutton to depart on floating command ship HMS Chatham. Remaining British forces to leave by air. All scheduled to be out by 3.30 am (1930 GMT).
* 1.30 am (1730 GMT) - Ceremony to swear in Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa, government officials, judges and provisional legislators. Convention Centre.
* 2.45 am (1845 GMT) - Provisional Legislature to hold first meeting after the handover to adopt handover-related laws.
* 6 am (2200 GMT) 4,000 troops of the PLA's Hong Kong garrison to arrive by land, sea and air.
* 10 am (0200 GMT) - The new Hong Kong government to host celebration for 4,600 guests. Tung makes inaugural speech.
* BEIJING - 4.30 pm (0830 GMT) - Premier Li Peng makes speech at reception in Great Hall of the People.
* 6.30 pm (1030 GMT) - Gala performance by local, mainland and international celebrities. Hong Kong Coliseum.
* BEIJING - 8 pm (1200 GMT) - Grand convention and artistic spectacle at Workers' Stadium, with Jiang to make speech.
* 8.30 pm (1230 GMT) - Hong Kong '97 Spectacular. Victoria Harbour fireworks display.
